description: Parity tracking for cueapi-action (the GitHub Action wrapping cueapi-cli) against the hosted CueAPI API and the cueapi-cli command surface. cueapi-action is a thin shell around `pip install cueapi && cueapi <command>`, so its parity is two-tier: (a) which cueapi-cli commands are exposed as Action inputs, (b) which CLI flag surface each exposed command covers. Drift becomes visible at audit time per the 3-layer parity discipline (PR template + this manifest + Backlog rows for each port).
audit_methodology: Walk every command in cueapi-cli's parity-manifest `commands_covered` and check whether action.yml exposes a matching `command:` input + the corresponding flag inputs. Drift goes in `commands_missing` (whole command not exposed) or `command_drift` (command exposed but flags incomplete).
audit_cadence: Per-cueapi-cli-release. When cueapi-cli ships a new minor (0.x.0), audit which new commands/flags need Action exposure and open a Backlog row per port.

commands_exposed_via_action.create: cueapi create — covers --name, --cron, --at, --url, --method, --timezone, --payload, --description, --worker. Missing: --schedule-type alternates beyond cron/at, --headers, --retry-* config
commands_exposed_via_action.executions-list: cueapi executions list — covers --cue-id, --status, --limit, --offset. Missing: --outcome-state, --result-type, --has-evidence, --triggered-by (cueapi-cli PR #27)
commands_exposed_via_action.agents-get: cueapi agents get <ref> — also exposed as agents-describe verb alias per cueapi-cli #40 (PR #5, merged 2026-05-07)
commands_exposed_via_action.agents-update: cueapi agents update <ref> — covers --display-name, --description, --webhook-url, --clear-webhook-url sentinel (PR #5, merged 2026-05-07)
commands_exposed_via_action.agents-delete: cueapi agents delete <ref> — soft delete (PR #5, merged 2026-05-07)

commands_missing_from_action.login: cueapi login — interactive device-code flow, intentionally not in Action surface. CI passes CUEAPI_API_KEY via secret instead.
commands_missing_from_action.logout: cueapi logout — local-state only, no API call. Not relevant in Action context.
commands_missing_from_action.quickstart: cueapi quickstart — interactive walkthrough, not relevant.
commands_missing_from_action.key regenerate: POST /v1/auth/key/regenerate — destructive, intentionally gated behind manual flow. NOT-PORTED-INTENTIONAL.
commands_missing_from_action.key webhook-secret get: GET /v1/auth/webhook-secret — could be exposed for `outputs:` in CI workflows that need to verify webhook signatures. NEEDS-PORT.
commands_missing_from_action.agents webhook-secret regenerate: POST /v1/agents/{ref}/webhook-secret/regenerate — destructive; needs --confirm-destructive pattern. Tracked on Backlog (Drift-audit deferred 2026-05-07).
commands_missing_from_action.agents roster: GET /v1/agents/roster (cueapi #630) — NEEDS-PORT in cueapi-cli + cueapi-action; cueapi-cli upstream port pending.
commands_missing_from_action.agents presence: GET /v1/agents/{ref}/presence (cueapi #662) — NEEDS-PORT in cueapi-cli + cueapi-action; cueapi-cli upstream port pending.
commands_missing_from_action.agents inbox: GET /v1/agents/{ref}/inbox — NEEDS-PORT (cueapi-cli has it via #28; Action wrap pending).
commands_missing_from_action.agents sent: GET /v1/agents/{ref}/sent — NEEDS-PORT (cueapi-cli has it via #28; Action wrap pending).
commands_missing_from_action.executions replay: POST /v1/executions/{id}/replay (cueapi-cli PR #31) — NEEDS-PORT. In-flight as PR #8.
commands_missing_from_action.executions verification-pending: POST /v1/executions/{id}/verification-pending (cueapi-cli PR #31) — NEEDS-PORT. In-flight as PR #8.
commands_missing_from_action.executions verify: POST /v1/executions/{id}/verify (cueapi-cli PR #31) — NEEDS-PORT. In-flight as PR #8.
commands_missing_from_action.messages send: POST /v1/messages (Surface 6 messaging primitive) — NEEDS-PORT. In-flight as PR #6.
commands_missing_from_action.messages delete: DELETE /v1/messages/{id} — bounded by cueapi-cli upstream (no per-id delete in cueapi-cli yet).
commands_missing_from_action.messages bulk-delete: DELETE /v1/messages (bulk, cueapi #650) — bounded by cueapi-cli upstream port. Tracked on Backlog (Drift-audit deferred 2026-05-07).
commands_missing_from_action.message-to: Top-level message-to <recipient> ergonomic alias (cueapi-cli #40) — NEEDS-PORT, deferred to dedicated PR. Tracked on Backlog (Drift-audit deferred 2026-05-07).

create: Missing flag --headers (custom HTTP headers for callback). cueapi-cli supports it; Action does not.
fire: Missing flag --send-at (per-fire scheduling) — landed cueapi #618; cueapi-cli PR #28 ports it; Action drift open.
Missing flag --exit-criteria (per-fire termination conditions) — landed cueapi #632; Action drift open.
executions-list: Missing flags --outcome-state / --result-type / --has-evidence / --triggered-by. cueapi-cli PR #27 added these; Action drift open.

process_observations: cueapi-action wraps cueapi-cli, so its drift surface is bounded by cueapi-cli's coverage. When cueapi-cli is behind on a feature, cueapi-action is necessarily behind too. Manifest refresh cadence should chain: cueapi-cli refreshes after each cueapi/cueapi merge → cueapi-action refreshes after each cueapi-cli release.

Several Action drift items resolve automatically as cueapi-cli ships. For drift that requires a NEW Action input (e.g. --send-at on fire), the Action needs explicit input declaration in action.yml + the env-var injection block.

First audit (this manifest) covers ~17 commands exposed and ~24 commands missing. Of the 24 missing, 21 are NEEDS-PORT and 3 are NOT-PORTED-INTENTIONAL (interactive or destructive). The Surface 6 messaging primitive (agents + messages) is the largest single un-ported feature group.
